title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Reschedule, No-Access and Missed Visit Figures
content:
## Dispatch bulletin: booking fees and credits by tier

The figures dispatch applies when a booked visit under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements is moved, cannot be performed for want of access, or is missed by the contractor are published per tier as follows.

| Tier | Elapsed hours before the scheduled visit start within which a customer reschedule counts as short notice | Fee for a customer-requested reschedule inside the notice period (USD) | Fee when the technician arrives for a scheduled visit and cannot access the equipment (USD) | Credit of the per-visit value when the contractor misses the visit window (percent) | Business days after the scheduled start within which a contractor-moved visit is not a missed visit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter & Belt Service Plan | 24 | 85 | 95 | 100 | 5 |
| Inspection Agreement | 24 | 85 | 110 | 100 | 5 |
| Preventive Maintenance Agreement | 48 | 125 | 145 | 100 | 5 |
| Labor Coverage Agreement | 48 | 125 | 145 | 100 | 3 |
| Full Coverage Agreement | 48 | 125 | 145 | 100 | 3 |
| Comprehensive Performance Agreement | 72 | 0 | 145 | 150 | 2 |

### Bulletin notes

- The short notice period is 24 elapsed hours at the two entry tiers, 48 at the three middle tiers and 72 at the Comprehensive Performance Agreement, where the short notice reschedule fee is 0 USD.
- The no-access trip fee is 95 USD at the Filter & Belt Service Plan, 110 USD at the Inspection Agreement and 145 USD at every tier above.
- The missed visit credit rate is 100 percent of the per-visit value at every tier except the Comprehensive Performance Agreement, where it is 150 percent.
- The contractor's grace period for a moved visit is 5 business days at the three lower tiers, 3 at the Labor Coverage Agreement and the Full Coverage Agreement, and 2 at the Comprehensive Performance Agreement.
